content: Yosepa Talinau Hi Pihigelgel-an
Yakobo i miminaa Kenani, labi toto valila tamana Aisake i miminaa.

He Yakobo alonau ge natunau liwaniliya i ola hiwe. Natuna Yosepa iya hevalina ya, wana baliman sebentin, iya sipi ge goti ana tomatahikan alonau ge talinau bolo tamana lagonau Bilha ge Silpa natuliyau. He talinau wali ginol nanakina wasana ni baubaunan tamaliya elana.

Yakobo alana etega al Isileli, wana nunuwana Yosepa elana wana nunuwana natunau bolau gegewel al elal i bwata lake, kaiwena wana sauga liki elana te Yosepa hi ab. Ana holahola yayapona etega i hel, matana i waisi ge nimana i yapu.
Talinau hi kite tamaliya wana nunuwana Yosepa elana wana nunuwana heliya elal i bwata lake, inoke Yosepa hi pihigelgel-an yaka nige nunuwana ana baaba hi baubaunan elana.
Sauga etega Yosepa i kenonou, inoke ana kenonou i baunan talinau elal, yaka abwe hi pihigelgel nabi elana.
He i baek elal i ba, “Ku laegan ge o kenonou na baunan nuku hago.
Tage kilau gegewela iyoho witi ta tomwatomwa ge ta kinkin eyowaa. Yaka nau o kin i lut ge i talmilil pasapu, ge komiu ami kin ona o kin hi milil painan ge hi kululuek elana.”
Yaka talinau hi baek elana hi ba, “Age u nuwatu nu tabwa wama kin ge nu logugui-agima?” He Yosepa ana kenonou i baunan talinau elal i ola to, inoke abwe hi pihigelgel nabi elana.
Yaka kenonou etega al i kenonou-an ge i baunan talinau elal i ba, “Ku laegan, kenonou etega al ya kenonou-an i ola hiwe. Tage sabwelu, weikena ge putum ali gewi elulutega maisena hi kululuem elau.”
Ana kenonou i baunan al tamana elana, yaka tamana i ba lalaan i ba, “Hauna kenonou u kenonou-an ei? Age u nuwatu alowau hinam ge talimwau naha nowa ge naha kululu elam?”
Yaka talinau hi lamwapulowan-an, yaa tamana kenonou o i nuwahikan atenaa ge i nuwanuwatu kaiwena.
Yosepa Talinau Hi Palian Boda Isimel elal ge Hi Ahe I Na Itipita
Sauga etega Yosepa talinau tamaliya wana sipi ge goti hi ahel hi na panuwa Sekemi ge hi matahikagil hi anan.

Inoke tamaliya Isileli i baek Yosepa elana i ba, “Talimwau heliya iyoho panuwa Sekemi sipi ge goti hi matahikagil hi anan. He nuwau na patunawa ge nu na elal.” Inoke Yosepa i talam i ba, “I waisi, na nok.”

Yaka tamana i baek elana i ba, “Nu nok nu na nu kite ebo talimwau hi mibubun ge ebo sipi ge goti hi waisi, inoke nu sikalim ge no wasa nu pem.” Inoke Yakobo Yosepa i patuna i egon, yaka labi o Hebiloni Abwabwina i eguluwan. Sauga i na i vin panuwa Sekemi,
inoke i nononawanawa ya labi o elana. Yaka abwe tau etega Yosepa i pwawa, ge i neli i ba, “Hauna gun u loloyaan e?”
Anana Yosepa i lahe i ba, “Taliwau ya loloyaagil, heliya wali sipi ge goti hi matahikagil. He tab bosowaina ge no wasa nu pem heliya ga?”
Anana i lahe i ba, “Iyaka hi egon. Ya hago hi ba, ‘Ta egon ta na panuwa Dotan.’” Inoke Yosepa i nouliulil talinau eliyaa i na i pwawaliya panuwa Dotan.
Sauga talinau mataliya i nok hi kite i nenem laha, inoke mulaa abwe i vin elal, heliya iyaka wali nuwatu hi pamaisena te nihi tagapaaliga.
He hi pebaaba-agil hi ba, “Ku kite, tokenokenonou iya huwo i nenem o!

Ehei, ta tagapaaliga, yaka tuwana ta alipaloek wewel kenken bolo ya etega gamwanaa. Inoke tamala wana wasa ta pek te iyaka bwasumu sosokana etega i an. Yaka abwe ta kite tab ana kenonou nihi tabwa tunahot.”
Wali baaba o Lubeni i hago inoke iya nuwana Yosepa ni pwamwal, yaka i ba, “Bahi yawalina ta pwapwamowasi.

He bahi ta tatagapaaliga. Ta alipaloek ya te wewel kenken toto ya gamwanaa labi kekevana ya elana, yaa bahi tuwana ta papalomwan.” He Lubeni i ba ola o nuwana Yosepa ni pwamwalem elal ge ni ahe ni pasikal tamaliya elana.
Sauga Yosepa i na i vin talinau elal, inoke hi lib ge ana holahola yayapona matana waiwaisana hi kukuleke yoho.
Inoke Yosepa hi ahe hi na hi alipaloek wewel kenken etega enoenovana gamwanaa.

Hi alipalo wewel kenken gamwanaa i mowasi, yaka hi na hi misiyo ge hi anan. Hi anan ee, abwe mataliya hi lihin boda Isimel hi kitel hi nenem avaliyau ge wali kamel. He aanan amnana ana epawaisi, bugul bwaleliya waiwaisana ge enonu meya hi usanil, hi neem labi Giliyad hi nana panuwa Itipita.
Inoke Yuda i baek talinau elal i ba, “Binimala ebo talila ta lol ge wana yaomal wasana ta sume, hauna waisi abwe ta pwawa?
He ta palian boda Isimel elal, yaka bahi tuwana ta papalomwan. Kaiwena iya talila hot, tuwala ge saliyala maisena ya.” Inoke wana baaba talinau hi talamwi.
Sauga panuwa Midiyani

tolobisnes hi vin elal, yaka Yosepa talinau hi na hi momol heyanem wewel kenken ana gola, ge hi palian boda Isimel elal molana mani silba ana gewi tuwenti. Inoke heliya Yosepa hi ahe ge hi na panuwa Itipita.
Yaka abwe Lubeni i sikal i na matana i lau wewel kenken gamwanaa nige Yosepa i kikite, yaka nuwana i nak nabi ge ana kama i kukuleli.
Inoke i sikal i na talinau elal ge i ba, “Geman Yosepa nige i gagan to wewel kenken gamwanaa o. He nasi ga na ola e?”
Inoke Yosepa talinau goti etega hi lol ge saliyana hi ahe ana holahola hi pasasaliya.
Yaka hi ahe hi na tamaliya elana ge hi ba, “Holahola yayapona ya ha pwawa. He u hile tab ana awa i ola natum ana holahola?”
Tamaliya holahola o i kite yaka i ba, “Ee, natu ana holahola te. Bwasumu sosokana etegana iyaka i an. Eu, natu geb! Bwasumu i alatomwatomwa-an!”
Yaka wana nuwanak kaiwena ana kaliko i kukuleli, kaliko toto bwasumu pupunona elana hi ginoliya i galoi, ge natuna baena i kahikahin sauga yayapona.

Natunau bolau ge yowau gegewel hi na elana tage nuwana nihi pawaisi, yaa i towa nige nuwana i oola. Inoke i ba, “Na kahikahin ya, ana siga na kahin aliga ge na na Tuma alou ge natu.” Inoke natuna baena i mimi kahikahin.
He Midiyani Yosepa hi ahe hi pwatanik Itipita ge hi palian Potipa elana. Potipa iya Itipita wali kin wana totuwalali bwabwatana etega, wana limi ana tomatahikan wali tohouwa.

footnotes.text: Toleleli alan labui i patuwalali, boda Isimel ge Midiyani, yaa tabam boda maisena ya bana.
